events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Big Day
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Celebrating the one and only Liam Gallagher on his 54th birthday. What's your favourite Liam moment, musical or otherwise?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released
events.blurb: John Lennon released his seminal album 'Imagine' on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine 55 Years
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to Imagine. A timeless message and an incredible album. Which track still resonates most with you?

events.title: First iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years ago, the original iPod changed everything for music lovers. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated globally as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred, and always on point! Happy James Bond Day. Who's your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and a legendary solo artist, would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese's Big Day
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, celebrating the brilliant John Cleese as he turns 87. What's the Cleese character that always makes you laugh?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. Which track from its incredible diversity is your go-to?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the irreplaceable Freddie Mercury, lead singer of Queen.

angles.name: Freddie's Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent and stage presence of Freddie Mercury. His voice and legacy live on. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: An album that truly marked a shift for The Beatles. 61 years ago, 'Rubber Soul' dropped. What's the standout track for you?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: 46 years on, John Lennon's spirit and music continue to resonate globally. A true legend never fades.
